entries.0057bf15256810cb: It purchases branded goods, precious metals, gemstones, antiques and art objects from individual customers.
entries.0c7f3e0451977b0d: The in-house auction “STAR BUYERS AUCTION” serves both as a sales destination for purchased goods and as a platform accepting consignment listings from partners, and its auction consignment ratio rose to 38.3% in the fiscal year ended August 2025. In purchasing, it combines a network of 139 domestic and 49 overseas stores with customer attraction through WEB marketing, and uses an in-house system that draws on accumulated purchase and sales data to standardize appraisals.
entries.18064a0aaaea4193: The company is advancing a three-year medium-term management plan, “To the Next Stage: For 2030 Revival Vision,” with the fiscal year ending August 2027 as its final year. It aims to improve profitability through structural reform, and, while carefully selecting investments in expanding retail and overseas sourcing, it sets six basic strategies (sourcing, auction, retail, overseas, business domain expansion and sustainability) toward realizing a “Circular Design Company” by 2030.
entries.1dd58cd998c53e3c: It purchases branded goods, precious metals, gemstones, antiques and art objects from individual customers. In Japan, purchasing is mainly done in-store at "NAMBOYA", "BRAND CONCIER" and "Kobijutsu Hakkodo" stores, and it also offers home-delivery purchasing, on-site purchasing and online purchasing. Overseas, purchasing is done at "ALLU"; as of August 31, 2025, the number of purchasing stores was 139 in Japan and 49 overseas.
entries.29f370e7a330b79d: A single-segment business centered on the purchase and sale of branded goods, precious metals, gemstones, antiques and art objects.
entries.31ab8f3287ac7105: Through the retail brand "ALLU", it sells vintage and antique products to general consumers.
entries.32c8c750f5e5fe27: It is expanding its handling of physical assets, including purchase, sale and maintenance of automobiles and real estate brokerage. It is also expanding its repair services.
entries.3873480946e15e3f: Precious metals such as gold and platinum, and products not suited to its own auctions or retail sales, are sold wholesale to businesses that specialize in handling them.
entries.46d05881fc9ca191: The company sells branded goods and other items purchased from individual customers through its own auction to reuse businesses in Japan and overseas, and also sells them to general consumers through retail stores and EC sites.
entries.4dba80d8eee451ac: Individual customers who want to sell branded goods and other items.
entries.65af1c9f7dc020fc: A single-segment business centered on the purchase and sale of branded goods, precious metals, gemstones, antiques and art objects. Valuence Holdings is a holding company; its domestic business is carried out by its core subsidiary Valuence Japan, while seven overseas subsidiaries purchase and sell products overseas. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥84,841 million.

entries.987b374a81146a0d: Valuence Holdings Inc. is a holding company headquartered in Minami-Aoyama, Minato-ku, Tokyo, and the group consists of 10 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 equity-method affiliate. The number of employees is 1,124 (as of August 31, 2025).

entries.b2ebc643cf57a10d: Holding company for the reuse business, headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo.
entries.b3ae4ab60ccf61af: Through the retail brand "ALLU", it sells vintage and antique products to general consumers. In Japan it has five stores in Ginza, Omotesando, Shinjuku and Shinsaibashi, and it also sells through its own EC site "ALLU online store" and cross-border EC.

entries.caf2acf6d3967a61: It sells purchased products to reuse businesses in Japan and overseas through its own auctions. Besides "STAR BUYERS AUCTION", which targets branded goods, it operates a diamond-only auction held in Hong Kong, "THE EIGHT AUCTION" for antiques and art objects, and "ALLU AUCTION" for general consumers. It also accepts consignment listings of products from partners.

entries.e5b35171aa2dbf64: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥84,841 million, up 4.1% year on year. By sales channel, the in-house auction accounted for ¥33,648 million, wholesale (precious metal bullion) ¥22,139 million, and retail ¥17,514 million.
entries.e7e5f649827c1f71: The domestic reuse market is expected to reach ¥4 trillion by 2030 (estimate by Reform Sangyo Shimbun). In terms of sales, sales to major customer Nihon Material Co., Ltd. account for 13.76% of the total, and sales to Net Japan Co., Ltd. account for 10.49% (fiscal year ended August 2025). The overseas share of revenue is 21.4%, and overseas operations are centered on Asia and the Middle East.

entries.fa59baf62aee80e6: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended August 2025 was ¥681 million, turning to profit from a net loss for the period of ¥1,709 million in the prior fiscal year. Revenue growth, supported by the expansion of retail and high precious metal prices, contributed to this result.
